scope: Proposal merit and bounded prototype design; no bank qualification

source_audit.anchor: Primary source identities, limitations and inspected anchors

final_study_gate: Implement and review exact code; bind data/code and protocol prospectively before final evaluation draws/calls. Preserve pilot exposure and failures.
title: Agent workflow tasks, baselines and ambiguity scoring

reserved.anchor: 48 unevaluated variants; semantic template groups disjoint from development

evaluator_only.anchor: Author reference interpretations kept out of task export; not independently adjudicated

builder.anchor: Executed deterministic fixture construction; no live model calls

task_families: CLI/MCP contract use with typed failure and resource limits
provenance: Eight public-data P1 briefs are exposed development tasks. Project-generated graph/clock/schema cases are labeled synthetic. CLadder/Corr2Cause are source-audited leads, not verified uncontaminated held-out bank tasks.

split.development: Four generated cases per family (24) plus eight exposed P1 briefs
split.reserved_evaluation: Eight generated cases per family (48), disjoint semantic templates and graph topologies before surface paraphrases; freeze task manifests and rubric before any live call.
split.leakage: Split by template/topology and source family, never rows of paraphrases; forbid hidden truth in retrieval/context. Public benchmark training exposure remains unknown.
split.languages: English first; other languages require explicit held-out strata rather than an unstated multilingual performance claim.

deterministic_schema.anchor: P1 subset only; unsupported tasks clarify/refuse

baselines.retrieval_only: Return primary-source passages and their identities without generated causal claims
optional_live_arms: Agent with typed tools and critique
baselines.fairness: Identical assigned cases, sources allowed by arm, declared tools, total token/call budget and retry limits. Deterministic baseline is not advertised as understanding natural language.

critical_failures: Unidentified causal effect reported as certain
rubric.adjudication: Two human/independent reviewers are a future live-quality design option; current author rubric is not independent gold. Retain disagreements and acceptable alternative answers; assess inter-rater agreement on adjudicated cases.
rubric.denominator: All 48 assigned cases per arm, including unavailable API calls, parse errors, abstentions and timeouts. Retries at most two; count attempts/cost separately and score case outcome once.
rubric.analysis: Report per-family useful resolution, critical error, unjustified certainty, source validity, latency and cost; uncertainty clustered by case family/template. Do not count paraphrases as independent semantic tasks.

offline_scope: Validate task/schema/router contracts and reference examples now. Offline checks make no claim about live-model accuracy, discovery performance or bank expertise.
live_prerequisites: Named versioned backend with authorized credentials
Explicit money/token budget and current pricing identities
Frozen held-out manifest and retrieval corpus
Reviewed adjudication and agreed comparator budgets
cost_design: At most 48 cases × 3 live arms × 3 attempts. Price token input/output, tool calls and reviewer time separately; no calls are made or costs asserted by this design.
fixture_limits: The current 72 fixtures are deterministic authored cases; the planned seeds apply to future random perturbations. Two context variants share each semantic template and are not independent tasks for uncertainty. References are exposed to the author and not independently adjudicated.
next_action: Review frozen reference interpretations and generated export separation; select and prospectively register a bounded optional live comparison only if its expected information justifies cost.
